_comment: Share cards (Open Graph and Twitter), one per page, keyed by the page's path (SiteShell's path prop). Each card is drawn by scripts/derive-imagery.mjs share from the page's own picture in Space colours, with the name, the page's public title and the picture's credit, and written to public/assets/img/share/<file> (1200 x 630 JPEG). SiteShell.astro reads file and alt. picture: mask = a page backdrop (path under public/assets/img), at = its anchor and k = its strength, as on the page (components/backdrop.css); opening = Home's opening print. After a change here, run npm run images:imagery -- share.
